series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Following Hisashi's tragic death on the school rooftop, Rei collapses in overwhelming grief beside his corpse. Takashi refuses to let her give up, forcing her to choose between surrendering to death or fighting for survival. Choosing to live, Rei attempts to contact her father, a senior police detective, for rescue. But with telecommunication networks completely severed and no emergency sirens sounding across the city, the two students realize civilization is paralyzed and they are entirely on their own.
Prior events (Part 2): Inside the locked school building, genius student Saya Takagi and bullied outcast Kohta Hirano take refuge inside a classroom. When Kohta clings to hope that the police or Self-Defense Forces will arrive, Saya bluntly crushes his optimism. She calculates that across Japan's population of 130 million, emergency responders will quickly be overwhelmed and infected themselves. Their grim debate is shattered by horrifying screams in the corridor outside, where students and teachers are dragged down and slaughtered against the frosted classroom windows. As bloody handprints smear the glass and the infected pound violently against their barricade, Saya and Kohta realize they must fight or be devoured.
Prior events (Part 3): Across the high school, two different battles for survival unfold. In the school infirmary, national kendo champion Saeko Busujima rescues school nurse Shizuka Marukawa. A first-year student named Ishii, bitten while shielding the nurse from infected staff, recognizes that his infection is fatal. Refusing to become a mindless monster, he begs Saeko to end his life with dignity, and Saeko delivers an honorable, merciful strike with her wooden bokken. Meanwhile, in the classroom, the infected breach the door and threaten to devour Saya. Bullying victim Kohta Hirano reveals an encyclopedic knowledge of firearms, rapidly modifying an industrial pneumatic nail gun into a deadly weapon. With icy precision and a manic grin, Kohta drives heavy steel nails directly through the undead attackers' skulls, obliterating the horde and proving himself a lethal survivor.
Prior events (Part 4): Exhausted and covered in gore on the school rooftop, Takashi turns on a high-pressure water valve. The cool spray washes away the dried blood of their fallen friends, providing Takashi and Rei a fleeting sanctuary of sanity and relief. But staring out across the skyline, black smoke and distant explosions reveal that help is never coming. Remaining on the rooftop ensures eventual starvation. Refusing to die waiting, Takashi and Rei make a pact to break through the infested school and search for their families. Armed with a metal baseball bat and a reinforced spear fashioned from a broom handle, the two teenagers push open the heavy fire door and descend into the bloodstained stairwells below.
